values: Part I.A floating solids and visible foam effluent limitation
Any permit definitions or compliance evaluation provisions for qualitative or visual effluent standards
Available reported observations or non-numeric results for floating solids or visible foam, if any
rationale: The packet establishes Part I.A's prohibition on floating solids and visible foam discharge 'in other than trace amounts' but does not define 'trace amounts' or supply any qualitative or quantitative threshold for compliance evaluation. Adjacent permit context covers sampling location, DMR reporting, and related oil/grease visibility standards, yet none of it specifies what quantity or appearance of floating solids or visible foam would remain within permitted trace levels. No reported observations or non-numeric monitoring results for floating solids or visible foam appear in the packet. Because the evidence neither establishes what constitutes trace amounts (ACCEPT burden) nor definitively forecloses any interpretive answer (REJECT burden), the obligation remains UNRESOLVED per the P5 preference for unsupported uncertainty over unsupported semantic closure.
